title: The specified compositor on three compactification candidates
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A and quasi-compact morphisms f:X -> Y and g:Y -> Z, let c_f,c_g,c_gf be compactifications of f,g,f g. For an object K of the full bounded-below etale-origin category on X, define candidateCompositor to be the four-factor composite of the c_g image of the comparison c_f to the chosen f candidate, the c_g to chosen g candidate comparison at originCompactSupport f K, the canonical originCompositionAmbient f g, and the comparison from the chosen composite candidate to c_gf. The comparisons and canonical composition are those of [def-sf-origin-candidate-comparison, thm-sf-comp-composition]. This is the existing construction relocated verbatim into a shared module; it selects no new maps.

proof.text: Compose the four specified comparison components in their given order. The endpoint compatibilities are the definitions of originCompactSupport and of compact support for the chosen compactification. This is a concrete construction, identical to its earlier declaration in the assigned module.

lean.statement:
def candidateCompositor (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g) (cfg : Compactification (f ≫ g))
    (K : (DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).FullSubcategory) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) cg).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) cf).obj K.obj) ⟶
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) cfg).obj K.obj
